lede: Notre Dame carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.3 against +1.7, a 8.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.

Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
